blurb: Guests can take horseback riding lessons at all levels year-round in indoor and outdoor arenas. Camps are offered for various ages and experience levels, including one-day barn days, multi-day break camps, and summer camps with riding, grooming, crafts, and games. The farm also provides training for horses and riders, and hosts a youth club with horse-related activities.
extraNote: Summer camps require $200 deposit; balance due first day of camp · Payment accepted by cash, check, credit card, debit card, PayPal · Year-round
